title: Eroding Self
description: The labyrinth does not just pleasure; it consumes. The longer you stay, the more your identity frays — your name, your past, your very sense of self dissolve like mist. If you do not escape soon, you will become a hollow, eternally satiated fixture of this dream.

fragments.prompt: The labyrinth erodes the player's identity, making escape a race against complete dissolution.
fragments.heavenRule: Whenever the player hesitates, tries to leave, or indulges too deeply, remind them of fading memories. Show moments of derealization.
fragments.contentBoundary: Memory loss must be shown through disorientation, not debilitating confusion that halts play.

generationHints.preferredUse: To prevent the player from simply staying and enjoying the fantasy; forces action.
generationHints.avoidUse: Do not make identity loss instant; it grinds down over interactions.

qualityNotes: Include moments like forgetting a family face or struggling to recall your name.
